## 2. What the Business Does

A multi-disciplinary contractor that lets public-sector buyers procure bridges, guarding and municipal web/ICT systems from one CIDB 6CE, PSIRA-registered entity with a verifiable KwaZulu-Natal delivery record.

**Products and services**: Civil works (bridges, roads, stormwater structures); security services (guarding, reaction, control-room operations); environmental reporting and socio-economic assessment; municipal websites, ZA-resident hosting and cloud helpdesk/call-centre deployments.

**Customers served**: South African public-sector buyers: local municipalities, provincial departments, water boards and municipal entities, principally in KwaZulu-Natal.

**How it is delivered**: Civil delivery to SANS/COLTO specifications with hired plant; web stack hosted in a ZA-resident Cape Town data centre; cloud call-centre platform resold under an implementer agreement.

---

## 3. Leadership & Ownership

Sipho Mthembu — Managing Director, BTech Civil Engineering (NQF 7), 18 years. Naledi Dube — Director: Operations (bid office). Thabo Radebe — Director: Security Services, PSIRA Grade B. Key personnel: Nomvula Khoza — N.Dip Civil Engineering (NQF 6), 9 years, site agent on two completed bridge contracts; Lerato Khumalo — BSc Computer Science (NQF 7), 8 years, web lead.
*   **Shareholding**: Sipho Mthembu 40%, Naledi Dube 35%, Thabo Radebe 25% (fictional demo split; 51%+ black ownership per the fictional SANAS certificate).
*   **Headcount**: Approximately 190 — 140 in the PSIRA security division per its PSIRA letter, plus civil works crews, the environmental unit and a four-person web/ICT unit.
*   **Key-person dependencies**: Sipho Mthembu is the only NQF 7 civil engineering lead; Thabo Radebe holds the security division's only PSIRA Grade B.

## 4. Track Record

uMzimkhulu low-level bridge — R14.9m, completed 2024. N2 interchange approaches — R28.4m, completed 2023. Rural access culvert programme — R8.2m, completed 2023. Three public-facing websites delivered, one for a municipal entity. Three helpdesk/call-centre deployments on 12+ month terms with contactable references. (All fictional demo projects.)

---

## 5. Operating Basis

*   **Key suppliers**: Readymix and aggregates suppliers on the KZN south coast; PSIRA-graded labour providers; a Cape Town ZA-resident data centre (hosting resold with a 99.9% uptime SLA back-to-back); a South-African-hosted cloud call-centre platform vendor under a reseller/implementer agreement.
*   **Standards and certifications**: CIDB 6CE contractor grading; PSIRA company registration; COIDA letter of good standing; SANS site safety files per contract (fictional certificates).
*   **Service commitments**: 99.9% hosting uptime SLA (back-to-back from the data centre); 24/7 reaction and control-room cover; defects-liability compliance on completed civil contracts.
*   **Continuity**: Hosting and call-centre services carry back-to-back SLAs with the ZA data centre and platform vendor; plant is hired per contract rather than owned; the bid pipeline is spread across four divisions so no single client or discipline dominates.
*   **Data protection**: operations are subject to POPIA.
